  • Method Details

    • startupSequence

      public void startupSequence(int stepNumber)
      Sequences through the animation steps during startup. Each step is controlled by animation completion events in the LG event system.

      Implementation: Each animation step specifies a duration (millisecs) and a next step number. When each animation completes, the next step is then called in the sequence. For some animations we don't care what the next step is so we set those to 99 (which gets caught by the default case).

      Parameters:
      stepNumber - the animations to perform in this step.
